title: A piece of junk! I am disabled and bought ...
text: A piece of junk! I am disabled and bought .... A piece of junk!  I am disabled and bought this to clean a floor since I cannot bend down.  Well, the small orange part that is supposed to tighten the handle, does not work; the handle slides down even when it is supposed to be tightened!  The brush part that is supposed to swivel...well, when you turn it to swivel, it becomes completely detached!  A piece of junk that needs to be redeveloped!

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Extendable Shower, Tub and Tile Scrubber - 42 inches
features: Great for tubs, tiles, glass, floors and narrow spaces
Extends from 26 inches to 42 inches with a quick twist. Scrubber: 5.8" x 4.4" x 0.6"
Anti microbial head is abrasive for deep cleaning, retains water for rinsing. Stored 2.25 x 4.375 x 25.75 Inches. Extended 42 Inch
Unique shape allows Scrubber to get into corners, recesses and grout lines
Replaceable head pivots for cleaning at different angles, Nylon construction
Lightweight steel pole with soft non slip grip, even when wet
description: The OXO Good Grips Extendable Tub and Tile Scrubber lets you clean the bathroom from top to bottom without climbing, crouching or kneeling. The Tub and Tile Scrubber extends from 26 inches to 42 inches with one quick twist, making it great for floors, tubs, glass shower doors, tile walls and more. The uniquely shaped Scrubber head pivots to clean at different angles and in tight corners. The lightweight steel pole is sturdy and features a soft, comfortable, non-slip grip, even when wet. Replacement Scrubber heads available separately.

details.Warranty Description: The oxo better guarantee: if you experience an issue with your oxo product, get in touch with us for a repair or replacement. We’re grateful for the opportunity to learn from your experience, and we’ll make it better.
